title: Fixed-stage coherent overlap comparison
statement: For the core data, a chosen stage k ≥ j, and a supplied overlap isomorphism e between the exact overlap restrictions of the pulled-back perfect objects, there exist the two-open comparison diagram and compatible local identifications with E satisfying the displayed overlap compatibility equation.

proof.text: At the chosen stage, instantiate the two-open comparison diagram from the prescribed open restrictions. Descend the local identifications of the pulled-back perfect objects with the restrictions of E, transport them through the canonical derived-pullback composition and open-restriction comparison isomorphisms, and use naturality and the coherence of the canonical transport maps. The overlap leg is the supplied isomorphism e₀ itself, so the transported square is exactly the displayed equation with d.toDiagram.HW.map e₀.hom.

proof_origin.note: Stage-3 decomposition of fixed-stage coherent transport using the supplied overlap isomorphism.

from.place: Fixed-stage coherent transport used by the core reduction
